tools.name: check_layout
tools.title: 檢查申論版面
tools.description: Use this when the user wants exact page usage, remaining capacity, overflow count, or compression priorities for a saved answer.

tools.name: create_answer
tools.title: 建立申論答案
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a new editable essay answer bound to a specific answer-sheet template. Sections support per-paragraph indentation, alignment, spacing, tabs, emphasis, and automatic heading styles.

tools.name: delete_text
tools.title: 刪除申論區塊
tools.description: Use this when the user explicitly wants to remove one section from an answer; the remaining sections are reflowed afterward.

_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: 段落已刪除並重新計算行數。

tools.name: export_docx
tools.title: 輸出申論 Word
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a fixed-grid A4 Word document; by default export is refused unless the answer fits the configured page capacity.

tools.name: export_pdf
tools.title: 輸出申論 PDF
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a fixed-grid A4 PDF for printing; by default export is refused unless the answer fits the configured page capacity.

tools.name: export_text
tools.title: 輸出申論純文字
tools.description: Use this when the user wants the authoritative wrapped answer as plain text with form-feed page breaks; by default export is refused unless the answer fits the configured page capacity.

tools.name: format_section
tools.title: 格式化申論區塊
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to change indentation, alignment, spacing, tabs, emphasis, heading style, or selected paragraph formats without resending or rewriting the section text.

_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: 段落格式已更新並重新計算行數。

tools.name: insert_text
tools.title: 插入申論區塊
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to add a new section at a precise position in an existing answer; the complete answer is reflowed afterward.

_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: 段落已插入並重新計算行數。

tools.name: list_answers
tools.title: 列出申論答案
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to find saved essay answers that can be reopened or edited.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.title: 列出答題紙模板
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to inspect available essay answer-sheet templates before creating an answer.

tools.name: load_exam_paper
tools.title: 載入申論答題紙
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to load a template or reopen an existing essay answer with its calculated grid layout.

tools.name: preview_delete_text
tools.title: 預覽刪除區塊
tools.description: Use this before delete_text when the user wants to inspect the affected answer and layout delta without saving it.

tools.name: preview_format_section
tools.title: 預覽格式修改
tools.description: Use this before format_section when the user wants to inspect proposed formatting and layout changes without saving them.

tools.name: preview_insert_text
tools.title: 預覽插入區塊
tools.description: Use this before insert_text when the user wants to inspect the proposed section and layout delta without saving it.

tools.name: preview_replace_text
tools.title: 預覽區塊修改
tools.description: Use this before replace_text when the user wants to inspect proposed text, heading, line-count, and overflow changes without saving them.

tools.name: preview_write_answer
tools.title: 預覽完整答案修改
tools.description: Use this before write_answer when the user wants a before/after diff, layout delta, and overflow result without saving the proposed answer.

tools.name: read_answer
tools.title: 讀取申論答案
tools.description: Use this when the user wants the complete structured answer, section metadata, and exact rendered lines.

tools.name: reflow_answer
tools.title: 重新排版申論答案
tools.description: Use this after content changes when the user wants the authoritative line-by-line wrapping and page assignment; it recalculates from stored sections without asking the model to estimate.

tools.name: render_answer_sheet
tools.title: 顯示申論答題紙畫板
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to view or edit a saved answer in an interactive canvas. Returns current answer/version and authoritative layout; 166 preview uses the original paper and exact font outlines.

tools.name: replace_text
tools.title: 替換申論區塊
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to revise one existing section without regenerating unrelated sections; optional paragraphs can replace the text with independent formatting, and the answer is reflowed afterward.

_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: 段落已修改並重新計算行數。

tools.name: write_answer
tools.title: 寫入完整申論答案
tools.description: Use this when the user has generated or rewritten the full answer and wants it stored as ordered editable sections; paragraph-level formatting is preserved and line count is delegated to the layout engine.

_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: 答案已寫入並完成排版檢查。

intentionalDifferences.reason: Optional version binding for legacy exports; strip only expectedVersion before base comparison.
New essay.read canvas tool opens ordered answers in one widget with question tabs and a selected full snapshot.
New essay.write batch create tool validates all items before saving and shares retry-safe create semantics.
Data reads no longer open the widget. Remove only base read_answer metadata before comparison; current read_answer must have no UI resourceUri or outputTemplate.
New essay.export tool combines ordered, version-pinned answers into one PDF or TXT, with page ranges and layout warnings.

Declared optional input additions: compact write/render responses default to summary with full opt-in; create records exam, question number, line targets and per-answer layout options in version 1, with retry-safe idempotencyKey. Strip exactly these optional properties before base comparison.
Base has no OAuth support; preserve Round B OAuth scope declarations. All other fields must equal base.
Compact output schemas shrink tools/list; each must stay a structural subset of the base schema.
New owner-only destructive tool (essay.write) removing an answer with its revisions and exports.
New editing, preview and version history tools: edit_text and restore_revision need essay.write; the list and the preview are read-only (essay.read).
New answer-management tools: rename or file an answer under an exam and question number and duplicate it (essay.write); export several formats at once with readable names (essay.export).
Loosened so the export tools can also return the readable fileName and, when the server has a public URL, a downloadUrl.
New writing tools (essay.write): move a section, renumber written item numbers, and set per-section line targets that check_layout reports against.
Loosened so check_layout can also return each section's lines against its target (sections, notes).
Removed: merged into the read-only preview_change, which takes the previewed write tool's name and arguments.
The widget URI carries a version so hosts drop a cached widget that calls removed tools; the base URI is restored before comparing.

intentionalDifferences.path: *.tools[*].inputSchema,*.tools[*].outputSchema,*.prompts[*].argsSchema: paragraph format and heading style fields
intentionalDifferences.reason: Format inputs drop their default keyword: an omitted field now inherits from the section and template instead of being reset to the default (Zod 4 fills defaults inside .partial()). Base defaults are removed before comparing.
Formatting tools append the 166 paper formatting limits; the base description stays the exact prefix.
